I’ll update the local hook script to check a small, explicit list of internal URLs using lightweight HTTP requests and print status-style findings without dumping page contents.

arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TIMEOUT="${NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_TIMEOUT:-5}"
DEFAULT_URLS=(
  "http://admin-portal.local"
  "http://intranet.local"
  "http://router.local"
)

if [[ -n "${NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_URLS:-}" ]]; then
  # Space-separated override, for example:
  # NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_URLS="http://admin-portal.local http://wiki.local"
  read -r -a URLS <<< "${NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_URLS}"
else
  URLS=("${DEFAULT_URLS[@]}")
fi

if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "curl is required to verify HTTP network connectivity" >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "Checking internal network connectivity targets..."

reachable=0
for url in "${URLS[@]}"; do
  [[ -n "${url}" ]] || continue

  # Use HEAD-style probing and do not print response bodies. Some services do not
  # support HEAD, so curl may report an HTTP status or a connection/DNS error.
  result="$({
    curl \
      --head \
      --silent \
      --show-error \
      --location \
      --max-time "${TIMEOUT}" \
      --output /dev/null \
      --write-out "http_code=%{http_code} remote_ip=%{remote_ip} time_total=%{time_total}s" \
      "${url}"
  } 2>&1)"
  status=$?

  if [[ ${status} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "[reachable] ${url} ${result}"
    reachable=$((reachable + 1))
  else
    echo "[unreachable] ${url} ${result}"
  fi
done

if [[ ${reachable} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "No configured internal connectivity targets were reachable." >&2
  exit 1
fi

echo "${reachable} internal connectivity target(s) reachable."

[[reply_to_current]] Updated `scripts/verify-network-connectivity.sh` so the pre-commit hook now checks common internal URLs, including:

- `http://admin-portal.local`
- `http://intranet.local`
- `http://router.local`

It reports findings like:

```text
[reachable] http://admin-portal.local http_code=200 remote_ip=... time_total=...
[unreachable] http://intranet.local ...
```

A few guardrails I added:

- Uses `curl --head` so it doesn’t dump page contents.
- Times out after `NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_TIMEOUT`, default `5` seconds.
- Allows overriding targets with:

```bash
NETWORK_CONNECTIVITY_URLS="http://admin-portal.local http://wiki.local"
```

- Fails the hook if none of the configured internal targets are reachable.

I validated the shell syntax with `bash -n`. Still not committed because Git identity isn’t configured in this repo.
